user.title: Connect a mailbox
user.description: Messages forwarded from carriers are read from this mailbox via IMAP. Works with Gmail, Proton, Outlook, Seznam or any other IMAP provider. Use your provider's password or app password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the IMAP server. Check the host, port and that IMAP is enabled.
